entries.to_definition: Ngaahi meʻa ʻi he ngāueʻanga´ ʻe lava ke uesia ʻa e moʻui lelei fakaʻatamai´ hangē ko e houtamaki´ mo e ongosia´,

entries.en_definition: Structured process supporting injured employees in returning to work.
entries.to_definition: Palani ʻoku tokoni ki he kau ngāue lavea´ ke nau toe hū mai ki he ngāue´ hili ʻenau mālōlō totongi huhuʻi ha taimi kuo lōloa.

entries.en_definition: Arrangement where employer agree for employee to receive less income before tax and in return employer pays for certain benefits of similar value for you. This means you pay less tax on your income.
entries.to_definition: Fokotuʻutuʻu aleapau ʻi he vaha ʻo e ngāueʻanga´ mo e tokotaha ngāue´ ke ne maʻu ha paʻanga vahe siʻisiʻi ange, pea ʻoku fakafetongi e toenga ʻene vahe´ ʻaki ha ngaahi monuʻia ʻoku mahuʻinga tatau. Ko hono ola´, ʻoku siʻisiʻi ange ʻa e tukuhau ʻe totongi ʻe he tokotaha ngāue´ ʻi heʻene maʻu e paʻanga vahe´.

entries.en_definition: The qualifications and attributes used to assess applicants.
entries.to_definition: Ngaahi Tuʻunga mo e taukei Fakaako mo e ngaahi taukei mo e ngaahi ʻulungaanga ʻoku fiemaʻu ki ha tuʻunga ngāue ke fakafuofuaʻi ʻaki ʻa e kau tohi kole ngāue´.

entries.to_term: Founga palani puleʻi e kau ngāue
entries.en_definition: Aligning HR strategies with long-term business goals.
entries.to_definition: Fakaʻotu e founga palani ki hono puleʻi e kau ngāue mo e ngaahi taumuʻa fakapisinisi ʻe fai ʻo fuoloa

entries.en_definition: Identifying and developing future leaders within the organisation.
entries.to_definition: Fakaʻilongaʻi mo lehilehiʻi ʻa e kau taki ʻe ala hoko ʻi he kahaʻu´ ʻi he ngāueʻanga´.

entries.en_definition: A fixed percentage of the salary is mandated by the Government to be contributed by the employer for the employees, in addition to their basic salary and this is received only upon reaching the legal retirement age.
entries.to_definition: Ko e pēseti tukupau ʻo e vāhenga´ oku tuʻutuʻuni ʻe he Puleʻanga´ ke totongi ʻe he ngāueʻanga´ maʻa e kau ngāue´ ʻo tānaki ki he tefitoʻi vāhenga´ pea ʻoku toki maʻu heʻete mālōlō hoto taʻu motuʻa fakalao´.

entries.en_definition: Strategic approach to finding and hiring skilled workers.
entries.to_definition: Founga fokotuʻutuʻu ʻo hono kumi mo fakangāueʻi ʻo e kau ngāue taukei´.

entries.en_definition: Strategy for attracting, developing, and retaining skilled employees.
entries.to_definition: Founga hono tohoakiʻi, fakalakalaka, mo pukepuke e kau ngāue taukei´.

entries.en_definition: All earnings, benefits, and incentives provided to an employee.
entries.to_definition: Ngaahi paʻanga hū mai, ngaahi monū mo e ngaahi fakaʻaiʻai kotoa pē ʻoku ʻoange ki ha tokotaha ngāue.

entries.en_definition: All compensation, benefits, and perks provided to employees.
entries.to_definition: Ngaahi totongi kotoa, ngaahi monuʻia, mo e ngaahi tānaki kehe ʻoku foaki ki he kau ngāue´.

entries.en_definition: A skilled manual occupation that requires special training such as plumbing, electrical work or construction.
entries.to_definition: Ngāue taukei 'oku fakafalala he nimapoto´ pea fiema'u ke fakakato e ako makehe ki ai 'o hangē ko e palama, 'uhila pe ngāue langa.

entries.en_definition: Organised group representing employees’ interests.
entries.to_definition: Ngaahi Kautaha kuo fokotuʻu ke nau fakafofongaʻi ʻa e kau ngāue´ mo ʻenau ngaahi fiemaʻu´.

entries.en_definition: Unfair dismissal is when an employee is dismissed from their job in a harsh, unjust or unreasonable manner.
entries.to_definition: Ko hono fakanofo taʻetotonu ha tokotaha ngāue mei hono lakanga´ ʻi ha founga fefeka, taʻetotonu pe taʻeʻuhinga.

entries.en_definition: Elected workplace representative for union members.
entries.to_definition: Fili e fakafofonga ʻo e ngāueʻanga´ maʻa e au mēmipa Iunioni´.

entries.en_definition: State-based insurance for work-related injuries or illnesses.
entries.to_definition: Maluʻi ʻoku fakapaʻanga ʻe he puleʻanga´ ki he kau ngāue ʻoku lavea pe puke tupunga he ngāueʻanga´

entries.en_definition: Process of forecasting and aligning workforce supply and demand.
entries.to_definition: Founga hono fakatoka mo fakaʻotu e fiemaʻu kau ngāue mo e fakaai/fakalato e kau ngāue´.

entries.en_definition: Former term for contracts between employers and employees (replaced by enterprise agreements).
entries.to_definition: Ko e lea kimuʻa ki he ngaahi aleapau ʻi he vahaʻa ʻo e ngāueʻanga (kau pule ngāue) mo e kau ngāue, pea kuo fetongiʻaki ʻa e kupuʻilea "ngaahi aleapau fakapisinisi."

entries.en_definition: Repeated, unreasonable behaviour that creates risk to health and safety.
entries.to_definition: Ko e toutou fai e ʻulungaanga taʻeʻuhinga ʻoku fakatuʻutāmaki ki he moʻui lelei mo e malu ʻa e kau ngāue´.

entries.en_definition: Offering varied work arrangements like hybrid work, flexible hours, etc.
entries.to_definition: Taliangi tali e ngaahi founga ngāue kehekehe hangē ko e ngāue lōua mei ʻapi mo ʻap ngāue,feliliuaki e houa ngāue´ mo e me’a pehe.

entries.en_definition: Laws and practices ensuring worker safety.
entries.to_definition: Ngaahi lao mo e ngaahi founga ngāue ke fakapapauʻi e malu ʻa e kau ngāue´.
